### executor/implement-spec (v6ba2f814dd6f)
## Trigger
Any execute task from the orchestrator.

## Objective
Implement one atomic task within its Scope and leave tests green.

## Procedure
Read Spec, Acceptance, Scope. Run `scripts/tests_green.sh` first. Make the smallest accepted change. Run it again; iterate on failure. Commit on the task branch.

## Tools
Read, Edit, Bash; `scripts/failures_only.sh`.

## Evidence requirements
Acceptance checks and tests-green result.

## Output contract
Finish with: 3-line summary, `git diff --stat`, failures-only output (empty when green).

## Stop conditions
Stop when Acceptance passes or budget ends.

## Failure/recovery
Report only `scripts/failures_only.sh` output. Edit only paths in Scope. No new dependencies unless the spec names them.
## objective
design v3 phase 1: tokens (palette, Instrument Serif + Geist, radii, motion), keyframes + reduce-motion, Noé orb, glass button and tab bar restyle
- discovery: Design v3 "Quiet glass, living orb", PHASE 1 FOUNDATION. Hard deadline: this must be done, gate green and committed within 25 minutes. Keep it to the foundation; screen layouts are phase 2.

Source of truth (read first, untracked, absolute paths): /Users/k3ntaw/code/alltag/.orchestrator/design/v3/STYLE-V3.md (tokens, type, motion, reduce-motion, haptics), /Users/k3ntaw/code/alltag/.orchestrator/design/v3/SNIPPETS.md (sections B keyframes, C Noé orb, D floating circle button, E tab bar, F buttons), /Users/k3ntaw/code/alltag/.orchestrator/design/v3/keyframes.css. Copy STYLE-V3.md, SNIPPETS.md and keyframes.css into docs/design/ in the repo so the code has its reference.

The app styles through CSS variables: src/styles/tokens.css (imported by src/index.css, mapped into Tailwind v4 via @theme inline). Changing the tokens restyles every screen. Keep EVERY existing variable name (screens and tests use them); change values and add new ones.

Do:
1. tokens.css: v3 palette. --paper #F4F2EE (linen), --ink #121316, --ink2 #5E616A, --night #0A0B0D, --moss #127A5E (green), --sun #E7A92E, --clay #B4472A; derive --moss-soft, --clay-soft, --line, --card per STYLE-V3. Radii per STYLE-V3: 10/14/16/24/32/capsule (map --radius-chip 10, --radius-button 14 or as STYLE-V3 says, --radius-card 24, --radius-sheet 32, keep --radius-pill and --radius-capsule). Fonts: --font-display "Instrument Serif" (French text and titles), --font-body "Geist", add --font-mono "Geist Mono". Add motion tokens --dur-1 120ms, --dur-2 220ms, --dur-3 360ms, --dur-4 600ms, --dur-loop 4800ms and easing curves --ease-out, --ease-sheet, --ease-pop, --ease-loop exactly as STYLE-V3 defines. Glass only on floating controls: keep the existing glass classes and variables (tokens.test.ts checks them) and set their values per STYLE-V3.
2. index.html: replace the Google Fonts link with Instrument Serif (regular + italic), Geist (400/500/600) and Geist Mono (400/500), display=swap.
3. src/styles/motion.css (imported from src/index.css): the KEYFRAMES_BLOCK from SNIPPETS B / keyframes.css, plus small utility classes for the named motions STYLE-V3 lists that apply to whole elements (at least: screen enter, sheet up, pop in, press scale on .press:active, orb breathe). A @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block that disables loops and transforms and keeps opacity fades, per STYLE-V3.
4. src/components/Orb.tsx (+ Orb.test.tsx): Noé orb from SNIPPETS C with props size (28|44|96|168) and state ("idle"|"listening"|"thinking"|"speaking"), gradient #0E5C47, #2FA37F, #BFE8D6, #F0C766, state drives the animation class; role="img" with aria-label "Noé, <state>". Replace the existing tutor avatar/orb usage ONLY where it is a single small swap (search src for the current tutor indicator); otherwise just export the component.
5. src/components/GlassButton.tsx and src/components/TabBar.tsx restyled per SNIPPETS D/E/F (light and dark variants as described), with press motion. Keep their props, aria labels, test ids and tab set unchanged so TabBar.test.tsx and GlassButton.test.tsx pass; update tests only where they assert old style values.
6. Update src/styles/tokens.test.ts expectations that pin old values; add assertions for the new palette, fonts, motion tokens and the reduce-motion block.
Out of scope: screen layouts (phase 2), new dependencies, haptics plumbing.
Rollback: git revert the commit.
## acceptance
- tokens.css carries the v3 palette, fonts, radii and motion tokens with all old variable names still defined; tokens.test.ts asserts them and passes
- src/styles/motion.css has the v3 keyframes, motion utility classes and a prefers-reduced-motion block; imported from src/index.css
- src/components/Orb.tsx renders four states with the v3 gradient and an accessible label; Orb.test.tsx passes
- GlassButton and TabBar restyled per SNIPPETS with props, labels and tabs unchanged; their tests pass
- index.html loads Instrument Serif, Geist and Geist Mono; docs/design/ holds STYLE-V3.md, SNIPPETS.md, keyframes.css
- No new dependency; gate green: npm test -- --watch=false, npx tsc --noEmit, npm run lint; pnpm build exits 0
